canonical_project: City of Unley Nutanix hyperconverged on-premises data centre refresh
notes: City of Unley migrated its ageing local-government infrastructure to Nutanix Enterprise Cloud HCI in 2018, consolidating approximately 10-12 racks of compute equipment to a small on-premises footprint supporting council workloads, smart-city data, GIS/3D modelling, contact-centre applications and DR. This is an enterprise/captive data centre modernization, not a public colocation or hyperscale project.
